title: Check yourself: Where instructions live and what loads when

questions.stem: An engineer wants a reminder about a private test server to guide Claude in one repository on their own machine, and never to reach teammates. Where does it go?

options.text: The committed instruction file, under a heading for personal items
options.says: Ruled out because "A personal note about one project, such as a sandbox address, belongs in the local file", and a committed file would share it.

options.text: A git-ignored local note beside the root instruction file
options.says: The local file is personal to one project and is kept out of version control.

options.text: The personal file in the home folder, applying to every project
options.says: Ruled out because that file reaches "You, in every project", and the reminder concerns one repository.

options.text: The organisation policy file, which only that engineer edits
options.says: Ruled out because that layer reaches "Everyone on the machine, and individual settings cannot exclude it", so it is not a private note.

questions.stem: A session starts at the top of a project, and an instruction file sits two levels down in `web/ui/`. When do its lines reach the model?

options.text: At launch, together with the root file
options.says: Ruled out because the files that load first are the ones "above the working directory are loaded at launch", and this one is below it.

options.text: Only after a restart that begins inside that directory
options.says: Ruled out because a lower file loads "on demand when Claude reads files in those directories", with no restart.

options.text: When the user runs the memory command
options.says: Ruled out because the memory command "lists your CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md, and other memory file locations" and loads nothing.

options.text: Once Claude opens something beneath that directory
options.says: A file below the starting directory loads on demand.

origin.section: What loads at launch and what loads later
